````text
# #3613: Patch: follow-up to #3464 from the after-merge spot-check
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

<!-- jackioh-bot:spot-check-follow-up #3464 -->
The after-merge spot-check of #3464 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42746562979)) found 1 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`efe8cdab2ebe`). `claude-1` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #3464 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `apps/web/src/cards/art/richness.ts:54`: ART_DETAIL_SHORT_MAX is 40, but fixtures/art-detail-short.json now names only 10 ids. That breaks the cap's documented ratchet ('its length as the last pass left it, so it can only shrink'), and R3352000 and the patch fragment's notes both record the cap wrongly.
  Evidence: At HEAD, art-detail-short.json holds 10 stinkyscape ids. The base fixture had 101 lines (99 ids) and this change removed 89. The doc comment above ART_DETAIL_SHORT_MAX says the cap equals the list's length after each pass, and every earlier pass followed that (561, 445, 337, 289, 157, 129). spec/rulings/R3352000.md says the cap 'falls from 129 to 40, the list's length as this issue left it', which is false: it is 10. spec/pending/3352.md says the same. crates/cards/patches/pending/every-classic-card-drawn-as-what-it-is-a-scene-3352.json `notes` says 'whose cap falls from 157 to 68', which matches neither the code nor the ruling. artRichness.test.ts only checks `listed.length <= ART_DETAIL_SHORT_MAX`, so 30 new shortfalls could join the list without the cap noticing. - Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

## Goal

Correct `ART_DETAIL_SHORT_MAX` in `apps/web/src/cards/art/richness.ts` from 40 to 10. Ten is the length of `fixtures/art-detail-short.json` today. Then add the missing history to the constant's doc comment, and correct the cap's numbers wherever #3464 recorded them wrongly: `spec/rulings/R3352000.md`, `spec/pending/3352.md`, the pending fragment's `notes` and `ART.md`.

The test `artRichness.test.ts` currently checks only that the list is no longer than the cap. Make it require the list's length to equal the cap. That stops a pass from leaving the cap above the list unnoticed, and the test fails at today's value of 40.

How the slip happened:
- Up to #3403, every pass set the cap to the list's length: 561, 445, 337, 289, 157, 129.
- #3431 (issue #3391, R3391000) took 30 Stinkyscape ids off the list, leaving 99, but deliberately left the cap at 129.
- #3464 (issue #3352) then took 89 Classic ids off and wrote 129 − 89 = 40, though the list was 99 − 89 = 10.

|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/cards/art/richness.ts` | change | `ART_DETAIL_SHORT_MAX` goes from 40 to 10; its doc comment's history is corrected |

| `spec/pending/3352.md` | change | "from 129 to 40" becomes "from 129 to 10" |

| `apps/web/src/cards/art/ART.md` | change | Line 813 ("129 to 40") and lines 824–825 ("at most") |
| `spec/rulings/R3331001.md` | change | The "**The ratchet.**" paragraph: the list's length equals the cap |

- `apps/web/src/cards/art/fixtures/art-detail-short.json` (it is already right).
- `spec/11-rulings.md` and `spec/INDEX.md`. Do not run `cargo jackioh spec index`.
- `crates/cards/patches/patches.json`. Its shipped notes are history.
- Any title in the front matter of `R3352000.md`, `R3331001.md` or `R3391000.md`, and the bold title in `spec/pending/3352.md`.
- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`.

Governing rulings: R3331001 (the detail floor and its ratchet), R3352000 (Classic's pass), R3391000 (the pass that left the cap at 129), R2529000 (visual claims).

   ```ts
   /**
    * The most `ART_DETAIL_SHORT` may name: its length as the last pass left it, so it can only shrink (561 after
    * #3331; 445 after #3390, R3390000, which took Classic+'s 116 off; 337 after #3392, R3392000, which took Core's
    * 108 off; 289 after #3393, R3393000, which took Meditative+'s and Training Grounds' 48 off; 157 after #3401,
    * R3401000, which took Meditative's 132 off; 129 after #3403, R3403000, which took the 28 of Stinkyscape's later

   The front matter stays unchanged.

- **`classify --claims`.** `richness.ts` is under `apps/web/src/cards/`, so `rust (classify)` counts it as a change to how cards look (R2529000). It needs a pending fragment with `"visual": true`. The 3352 fragment is one and stays pending, so the claim holds without a fragment of this PR's own.
  - If `patches ship` moves the 3352 fragment into `patches.json` before this merges, this PR conflicts on the deleted file. Then drop step 5 (a shipped note is history) and add a visual fragment of this PR's own with `cargo jackioh patches "<title>" --visual`, per `docs/issues-and-patches.md`.

A branch in flight that removes the remaining Starship Pieces or Olivian Expanse ids and leaves the cap (as #3391 did) will fail `web` in the merge queue until it lowers the cap. - **`spec check`.** Only bodies change, plus `[[R3391000]]`, which exists. Titles, `proven_in` and the R-ids in test names stay the same, so the generated index does not drift.

None needs a person. Decisions made here, each with the alternative rejected:

- **ART.md and R3331001.md are fixed too.** The issue names neither file, but ART.md repeats the wrong "129 to 40" and R3331001 describes the check this PR changes. I rejected leaving them stale.
````
